Findings (2026-02-14):

Potential follow-ups:

Outline / writing notes (proposed):

- Classification section README (02-classification/README.md):
  - Add a short 'why two models' comparison: Naive Bayes (fast CPU baseline) vs HF sequence classifier (stronger, slower, GPU-capable).
  - Add a short 'mock-first' testing recipe that mirrors the docs (tactus test --mock, then train/evaluate).
- Ensure every trainable model example has deterministic specs that assert real branching outputs (yes/no/review) via Mocks conditional returns.
- Add a small 'Troubleshooting training' section:
  - missing extras -> install tactus[ml] or tactus[hf]
  - first run downloads dataset -> expect time/space
